settings.description: Experimental: exchange matching primary weapons across a squad when collected, and drop squad weapons on final wipe. GOG and Steam 2026-09 builds only. Restart required.

Outgoing primary ammo on squad replacement: discard removes its shared-ammo share, transfer puts that share on the old-primary pickup, retain keeps it as unused squad reserve. Incoming pickup ammo is imported once independently of this choice. Values: discard, transfer, retain. Restart required.

Shared ammo on final squad wipe: discard leaves drops empty; transfer distributes available unreserved shared rounds once across compatible primary drops. Loaded magazine reservations and unused retained reserves are excluded. Values: discard, transfer. Restart required.
